messages:
Priya (Sales): quick handoff for Auriga Labs - they're ready to move from hosted eval to a private deployment trial. main asks: SSO+SCIM (Okta), HSM/KMS integration, and predictable p99 latency for short prompts. renewal ~10 months.
Miguel (CSM): thanks Priya. who's the partner contact and do they require a contract addendum for data residency?
Priya (Sales): contact is sanjay@aurigalabs.com (Sanjay Rao). They want EU data residency and an MSA addendum for encryption-at-rest w/ HSM.
Ravi (Onboarding PM): couple questions: do they want SP-initiated SSO or IdP? Also are they asking for a persistent peered VPC or temporary PoC networking?
Priya (Sales): Okta, SP-initiated. They prefer a week-long PoC using VPC peering, then evaluate dedicated private for Q3.
Keisha (Support Eng): noted. We'll need their VPC CIDR, a point of contact for peering approvals, and HSM vendor (Thales or AWS CloudHSM?). Also: do they expect us to provision any keys or will they bring keys?
Priya (Sales): They use AWS CloudHSM and want to bring their own keys; key exchange contact is Sanjay + infra-sec@aurigalabs.com.
Arman (Solutions Eng): For the PoC, recommend a 2-node private pool with A40 equivalent to meet 15 TPS p95 for 384-token prompts. Need an example input distribution and target throughput.
Priya (Sales): They estimate ~10M tokens/month, mostly short interactions (avg 120 tokens). Peak ~18 TPS.
Miguel (CSM): I'll open the onboarding doc under /cs/onboarding/auriga and track items. Proposed owners: 1) Security & HSM integration - Keisha (Support Eng) - due 2026-04-08. 2) SSO/SCIM setup - Ravi (Onboarding PM) - due 2026-03-30. 3) PoC infra provisioning - Arman (Solutions Eng) - due 2026-04-10. 4) Commercial sizing & contract addendum - Priya (Sales) - due 2026-03-28. 5) Enablement + feedback capture session - Miguel (CSM) - schedule by 2026-03-31.
Keisha (Support Eng): I'll create the security ticket and ping EngSec. Need org approve from auriga infra team for network peering. I'll also ask EngSec about HSM key import process and egress rules for KMS calls.
Ravi (Onboarding PM): SCIM + SSO checklist: we support Okta SCIM v2 and SP-initiated SAML. I'll send a setup guide and a small test plan to Sanjay.
Arman (Solutions Eng): Can Sanjay share 50 sample prompts (redacted) and a small synthetic traffic file so we can tune batching/KV cache? Also share whether weights are their own fine-tuned model or a standard curated one.
Priya (Sales): They plan to bring a fine-tuned Falcon-derived model (internal weights) but willing to run a staged test on our curated 70B equivalence. I'll ask for prompts + traffic.
infra-bot: Onboarding doc created at /cs/onboarding/auriga; owners added.
Miguel (CSM): risk callout: competitor outreach was mentioned on the last call; speed of PoC is critical. Suggest we front-load latency p99 testing and a short perf report in the enablement session.
Keisha (Support Eng): Network snippet we usually request from customers:
```
# sample customer VPC route to allow peering
resource "aws_route" "to_redwood" {
  route_table_id         = "rtb-abc123"
  destination_cidr_block = "10.20.30.0/24"
  vpc_peering_connection_id = "pcx-xxxxxx"
}
```
Keisha (Support Eng): Also need their peering approver contact and expected maintenance windows.
Priya (Sales): I'll share Sanjay + infra-sec contact and ask for CIDRs and sample prompts by EOD tomorrow.
Ravi (Onboarding PM): I'll tentatively book a 30-min kickoff for next Tue and will cancel if prompts not received.
Arman (Solutions Eng): once we have sample prompts, I'll run a quick local perf sweep and post results to the onboarding doc.
Miguel (CSM): please react with :thumbsup: if you accept owners/dates or reply if changes.
Priya (Sales): :thumbsup:
Keisha (Support Eng): :white_check_mark: starting security ticket now.
Arman (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup:
Miguel (CSM): thanks team 1 I'll follow up with the onboarding doc link and schedule. We'll escalate to eng-oncall if HSM import or peering hits blockers.
